items.excerpt: watchOS 27 beta 3 brings Apple's revamped LLM-powered Siri and a dedicated Siri app to the Apple Watch for the first time, turning the wrist wearable into a full Apple Intelligence device that can hold back-and-forth conversations and take in-app actions (processed via a paired iPhone).

Apple's new AI-driven Siri experience has arrived on Apple Watch in watchOS 27 beta 3, adding personal-context awareness, broader world knowledge, and on-watch conversational Siri that can search Mail, Messages, Calendar and other apps and relay results to the wrist.

A new report says Meta is testing a 'super-sensing' mode for its smart glasses that continuously records audio and snaps photos every few seconds to build persistent AI context — and may switch off the privacy LED — reigniting concerns about always-on AI eyewear.

One day after praising Meta's smart-glasses privacy update, Tom's Guide reports that Meta's 'super sensing' AI glasses — which continuously watch and listen to build persistent context — undercut those protections, spotlighting the tension between ambient AI capabilities and bystander privacy.

Meta is pushing a mandatory update that fully disables the camera on its Ray-Ban, Oakley and new $300 Meta glasses if the capture LED is blocked or physically tampered with, closing a privacy loophole exploited by paid LED-disabling mods.

Samsung is developing a dedicated AI accelerator chip codenamed 'Gaia' to handle on-device AI workloads in PCs, aiming to speed up local AI 'chores' on-silicon, with mass production potentially starting in 2027.
